note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Prepare statements run in one PowerShell session with the episode folder as current directory; variables do not survive into the screens, so each screen re-derives what it needs.
prepare: # owner signed in off camera: gh auth login. One GitHub identity only: the review is a Comment review (authors cannot approve their own pull request).
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force C:\work | Out-Null; Remove-Item C:\work\orders-app-review-demo -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if (gh repo view "$owner/orders-app-review-demo" --json name 2>$null) { gh repo delete "$owner/orders-app-review-demo" --yes }
git init -q -b main; git config core.autocrlf false; git config user.name 'Lab Admin'
git add -A; git commit -q -m 'chore: baseline (orders API from episode 5)'
gh pr create --title "feat(orders): cancel an order" --body-file "$ep\src\review-demo\pr-body.good.md"

screens.name: pr-open
steps: Conversation tab: the title, the four-section description, the Checks box with pr-size, pr-description and review-routing all green
Open the pr-size run Summary: 'size/S: 31 changed lines in 3 files' and the area table; then the review-routing summary (the account for every file)
In Windows Terminal (C:\work\orders-app-review-demo, with $ep = the episode folder) run: gh pr edit 1 --body-file $ep\src\review-demo\pr-body.bad.md
The pr-description check re-runs (edited trigger) and turns red with the four findings
Restore with: gh pr edit 1 --body-file $ep\src\review-demo\pr-body.good.md   and show it green again
mask: GitHub account name if it is not the public lab account
never show gh auth status or tokens
patch author is the fictional Alex Demo; no real names or addresses

screens.name: review
steps: Files changed: hover the 'order!.Status' line, add a comment 'issue (blocking): ...' and click the suggestion button to show the suggestion block
Post the whole review at once: python $ep\src\review-demo\review-payload.py > review.json   then   gh api repos/<owner>/orders-app-review-demo/pulls/1/reviews --input review.json
If the API rejects the multi-line comment, post the review with single-line comments only and add the suggestion by hand in the UI
Conversation tab: the review with seven threads, review type Comment (say on camera that approve and request changes are not available to the author)

Windows Terminal: gh api repos/<owner>/orders-app-review-demo/pulls/1/comments --paginate > comments.json   then   python tools/review_kit/cli.py comments comments.json   -> label table and 'Blocking (3)'
mask: GitHub account name if it is not the public lab account
never show gh auth status or tokens
patch author is the fictional Alex Demo; no real names or addresses

screens.name: followup
steps: Terminal: git am "$ep\src\review-demo\0002-fix-orders-answer-404-for-an-unknown-order-and-409-w.patch"   then   git push
Checks re-run: pr-size now 'size/S: 67 changed lines'; Files changed shows the new tests
Reply to the three blocking threads (replies from review-comments.json, ids 108 and 109) and click Resolve conversation on each: 'All conversations resolved'
Squash and merge, delete the branch (the kit only runs on pull requests, main gets no run)
Say on camera that with two people the ruleset from episode 1 also needs an approval, which one account cannot give
mask: GitHub account name if it is not the public lab account
never show gh auth status or tokens
patch author is the fictional Alex Demo; no real names or addresses

screens.name: metrics
screens.note: One merged pull request: lines, hours to merge and 'Never reviewed by anyone but the author: #1' (the author's own Comment review is ignored on purpose). If Lines shows '-', note it in the README.

teardown: $owner = gh api user --jq .login; gh repo delete "$owner/orders-app-review-demo" --yes
